title: CalibrationProposal
description: A governed proposal to recompile a role policy into the NEXT contract version. Calibration NEVER directly modifies weights, gates, thresholds, or model parameters and NEVER retrains hidden weights: it proposes declarative policy-artifact changes (targets) with rationale/evidence, and an APPROVED proposal is routed back through the Hiring Policy Compiler on a human-edited policy to produce a new versioned HiringWorkflowIR + Hiring Decision Contract. The active contract is never mutated in place. Tracks ugence_ai_hiring.hiring_decision.reviews.CalibrationProposal (enriched).

source_case_ids.description: Full cohort the proposal draws on.

contract_ref.description: The current WorkflowIR / Decision Contract version being calibrated.

targets.description: Declarative policy artifacts proposed for change — never model parameters.

recompile_policy_id.description: The policy to recompile — calibration recompiles a policy, it never retrains hidden weights.

supporting_evidence.description: Report id + review ids + receipt ids backing the proposal.
